# PR #9 API compatibility fixture

The `Contract` directory snapshots the `PiSharp.Extensions.Abstractions` sources
from main commit `15b7acceb9c41a5b278b005ac5df6dadad7cda48`. The extension is
packed with the original assembly identity and API manifest version 1. The
current host must load and run its command, shortcut, and session-lifecycle
registrations.
